# The operator algebra of the integrated test operators

Module `Langlands.Representation.Unitary.TemperedComponentAlgebra` fixes a unitary, jointly
continuous representation `π` of a second countable locally compact group `G` on a complex
Hilbert space `H` and introduces two subspaces of `H →L[ℂ] H`:

* `algebra μ π hπ`: the closed unital `*`-subalgebra generated by the integrated operators `π(φ)`
  of all test functions (`testOps`); it is a C*-algebra of operators;
* `leftIdeal μ π hπ`: the closed span of the products `π(φ) y` with `φ` a test function and
  `y ∈ algebra` (`leftGenerators`).

It also defines words in group elements and test functions (`TestFn`, `Word`) and their operators
`letterOp`, `wordOp` (products of `ρ(g)` and `ρ(φ)` for any jointly continuous `ρ`).

## Declarations

| Declaration | Content |
| --- | --- |
| `intertwiner_comp_wordOp`, `wordOp_mem` | intertwiners commute with word operators; closed invariant submodules are stable |
| `algebra_isClosed`, `leftIdeal_isClosed`, `testOp_mem_algebra`, `leftIdeal_le_algebra` | basic membership |
| `testOp_mul_mem_leftIdeal`, `testOp_mem_leftIdeal` | `π(φ) y ∈ leftIdeal` for `y ∈ algebra`; in particular `π(φ) ∈ leftIdeal` |
| `mul_mem_leftIdeal_of_generators` | a left multiplication preserving the generators preserves `leftIdeal` |
| `norm_map_rep`, `inner_rep_left`, `norm_rep_le` | unitarity: `‖π(g) v‖ = ‖v‖`, `⟪π(g) u, v⟫ = ⟪u, π(g⁻¹) v⟫` |
| `rep_mul_mem_leftIdeal` | `π(g) x ∈ leftIdeal` for `x ∈ leftIdeal` |
| `continuous_rep_mul` | for `x ∈ leftIdeal`, `g ↦ π(g) x` is continuous in operator norm |
| `testOp_mul_eq_integral` | `π(φ) x = ∫ φ(g) • π(g) x dμ(g)` as an operator-valued Bochner integral |
| `star_testOp_apply`, `star_testOp_mul_eq_integral` | `π(φ)^* u = ∫ conj φ(g) • π(g⁻¹) u` and the operator version on `leftIdeal` |
| `star_testOp_mul_mem_leftIdeal` | `π(φ)^* x ∈ leftIdeal` for `x ∈ leftIdeal` |
| `algebra_mul_mem_leftIdeal` | `leftIdeal` is a left ideal of `algebra` |
| `wordOp_mul_mem_leftIdeal` | word operators preserve `leftIdeal` |

## Proofs

Left norm continuity holds on the generators by `continuous_comp_testOp`
(`π(g) π(φ) = π(φ(g⁻¹ ·))` and continuity of translation in `L¹`), and passes to the closed span
because `‖π(g)‖ ≤ 1` makes the approximation uniform in `g`. For `x ∈ leftIdeal` the unweighted
orbits `g ↦ π(g) x` and `g ↦ π(g⁻¹) x` are therefore continuous and `leftIdeal`-valued, and their
products by `φ(g)` and by `conj φ(g)` are Bochner integrable and `leftIdeal`-valued (they need not
be continuous, since `φ` is only measurable). So `π(φ) x` and `π(φ)^* x` are Bochner integrals of
`leftIdeal`-valued integrable functions and lie in the closed subspace `leftIdeal`
(`integral_smul_mem_of_continuous`). The set of `c` with `c · leftIdeal ⊆ leftIdeal` is a closed
subalgebra containing every `π(φ)` and `π(φ)^*`; since `algebra` is the closure of the algebra
generated by these operators (`StarAlgebra.adjoin_toSubalgebra`), it is contained in that set.
No modular function is needed: only left translations of test functions occur, because the
adjoints are handled by the integral formula for `π(φ)^* x`.

## Provenance

Internal; the subspaces are auxiliary to the proof of
`Langlands.Analysis.TemperedIrreducibleComponentStatement`.
